## Group emotes, premium feel, safer broadcasts

The menu becomes social this release. When you play an emote, nearby players can see it and join in with one key. When you walk near someone emoting, you can copy what they're doing. The whole UI got a polish pass on top, and busy servers get extra protection against spam.

### Open Join — anonymous group emotes

When you start a danceable or shared emote, every player within a few meters gets a small pill at the bottom of their screen with the emote name and a hotkey. One press joins the same emote on their character. Your name is **never shown** to them — only the emote.

![Open Join in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-open-join.png)

- Each player can opt out with `/mbt_openjoin off`, opt back in with `/mbt_openjoin on`
- The pill goes away on its own if you walk off or stop the emote, no lingering invites
- Server owners can choose which emote categories broadcast, the radius, the key, and a max number of recipients so a crowded club doesn't get spammed

### What's That Emote? — peek and copy

Walk near someone who is emoting and a small bubble appears above their head with the emote name and a hotkey hint. One press copies it onto your own character.

![What's That Emote bubble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-whats-that.png)

Off by default — your server admin can enable it in the config. The bubble follows the player's head smoothly and disappears as soon as they stop or you walk away.

### Nearby ribbon

When at least one other player is in range, a dedicated ribbon shows up at the top of your menu with your most-played shared emotes. One click starts a duet with the closest player. The featured chip leads the row, and you can jump to the full Shared category if none of the six suggestions are what you want.

![Nearby ribbon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/7388c9d/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-nearby-ribbon.png)

### Drag-to-reorder favourites (now actually working)

![Favourites reorder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_emote_menu/f131311/.github/release-assets/v1.3.0-favorites-reorder.png)

The favourites tab has had a drag-and-drop affordance for a while, but the underlying browser layer in FiveM was silently dropping the gesture. Rebuilt from scratch so dragging a favourite card now sticks to the cursor, the target slot lifts up to show where it'll land, and the new order is saved permanently — survives reloads, restarts, and reconnects.

### Premium polish

- Pills and bubbles enter with a soft slide + scale-up and a one-shot accent ring pulse on arrival, exit snappy when dismissed
- Tabs slide directionally when you switch between All / Favourites / Recent / Top
- The grid does a subtle fade-in when you change filter, category, or sort — feels like the new set "settles in" instead of snapping
- Counters next to the search bar, the Nearby badge and the Recent tab count up and down with a spring instead of jumping
- "No emotes found" and the empty Partner Finder got a real empty state with a floating icon and an arrow pointing to the action that fixes the emptiness
- Creating a new custom list now pulses the new chip inline instead of firing a toast — you see what you just created
- Everything respects your "reduce motion" OS setting and falls back to a quiet opacity fade

### Safer in busy servers

- **Banned emotes list** — server owners can blocklist specific emote names. Both the catalog and the Open Join broadcast respect the list
- **Anti-spam cooldown** — short delay between back-to-back emote plays so a stuck key can't spray your character
- **Crowd protection** — Open Join only reaches the 30 closest players by default, so a packed nightclub doesn't turn into a notification storm
- **Anti-spoofing** — the server checks that the announced emote matches what the initiator is actually playing before relaying it, so nobody can advertise an emote they're not running

### Smoother first open

If you pressed the menu key while the server was still finishing the emote list (typical on first spawn after connecting), the menu would silently fail and you'd have to press a second time. It now remembers the intent and opens by itself as soon as the list is ready.

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots and custom lists are kept.

If you previously bound the Emote Wheel hotkey, double-check **FiveM Settings → Key Bindings → MBT Emote Wheel (Hold)** after the update — FiveM caches keymappings per-resource and the binding may need re-confirming.

Requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest.
